access-appearance-specimen.purpose: Exercise one access or appearance owner in the bank with local example state and no authentication or saved preference.

access-experience.purpose: Show the access screen over the wallpaper: the onboarding form, the lock screen or the connection state, with its error.

access-form.purpose: Create an identity in two steps, identity then appearance, or unlock an existing one.

access-gate.purpose: Hold the product behind access: show the access screen until a session is ready, then the view product.

access-screen.purpose: Sign a person in to the product through the access experience, with the remembered profile and appearance.

action.purpose: Invoke one command with a text button or an icon button, never competing text and icons.

appearance.purpose: Choose the interface appearance and see whether the choice could be kept.

appearance-preferences.purpose: Choose mode, text size, tint and a system wallpaper with immediate local preview.

appearance-preview.purpose: Compare Dark and Light using the same surface, tint and wallpaper tokens as the running interface.

appearance-root.purpose: Apply the chosen appearance to the whole page and publish the system colour scheme.

artwork-placeholder.purpose: Stand in for the missing cover artwork of audio or poster of video with the glyph of its media kind.

attention-indicator.purpose: Mark objects needing attention with the same amber indicator everywhere, steady when reduced motion is enabled.

attention-list.purpose: Bring every object or activity needing the identity’s attention into one consistent Home list.

attention-status.purpose: Pair the shared attention indicator with readable context for the attention signal.

availability.purpose: Understand whether a capability is ready, unavailable or not yet known.

avatar.purpose: Show a person or identity as a seeded drawing, a picture or initials, optionally as the button that shuffles its seed.

avatar-shuffle.purpose: Generate a new avatar seed on activation and reveal the shuffle overlay on hover or focus.

bar.purpose: Keep navigation and contextual commands in the surface toolbar; reveal its title and subtitle only after the content header scrolls away.

card.purpose: Open one item, media, collection or summary from a card composed of artwork and its supporting content.

catalog-card.purpose: Open a media item from a card composed of artwork and its supporting content.

catalog-detail.purpose: Read one catalog item with its media and details in the current destination.

catalog-home.purpose: Arrange a catalog overview from the same content, media and navigation compositions.

catalog-navigation.purpose: Declared as found at the start of the migration: CatalogNavigation.svelte.

catalog-search-results.purpose: Show what a search in one destination found, as record cards or grouped result rows, and open one result.

catalog-workspace.purpose: Host a catalog place with its navigation sidebar, toolbars, search overlay, panels and failure dialog.

catalog-workspace-content.purpose: Show the body of the catalog workspace: the visited views of a program, or the public catalog's browse, exercises and bank places.

character-counter.purpose: Count the characters of a text value, or how many remain before its limit and by how many it is over.

choice.purpose: Choose one or several options given as data, as rows, cards, swatches or a menu, with a persistent label.

choice-item.purpose: Lay out one choice as its selection mark beside a title and an optional description.

choice-list.purpose: Hold the rows of a single or multiple choice in one transparent geometry inside its host.

choice-row.purpose: One pressable row of a choice list whose label activates the checkbox or radio it holds.

clear-input.purpose: Empty a text control in one press, keeping its masks and undo history, shown only while it holds a value.

clock.purpose: Show today's date and the current time, kept current while shown.

collection.purpose: Browse objects with shared row geometry, or present media in a gallery.

collection-state.purpose: Show a collection's loading, empty or offline state inside a grouped panel.

color-bullet.purpose: Show a label’s color alongside its text without using color as its only meaning.

column.purpose: Stack pieces vertically with a gap from the spacing scale, at the reading, narrow or wide measure, aligned or centred.

confirmation-dialog.purpose: Ask for explicit confirmation in a compact temporary surface with clear primary and secondary actions.

content-flow.purpose: Arrange reading, overview or gallery stacks within the shared content measures and responsive layout.

context-panel.purpose: Read an object and use its contextual commands without leaving its destination.

context-properties.purpose: Read related facts and use state commands in one shared pane, separate from reading paragraphs.

contract-inspection.purpose: Read the declared contract, coverage gaps and evidence of one resolved node kind.

control-bench.purpose: Exercise every control specimen locally in the bank, reporting each interaction without any product command.

control-renderer.purpose: Mount the piece for one control node and forward only its control events.

date-control.purpose: Choose one day from a month calendar opened from a labelled field well, within optional bounds.

destination-row.purpose: A grouped row that opens one destination, or shows why that destination is unavailable.

drawer.purpose: Open a temporary surface over its parent with content and top or bottom toolbars, never lateral child surfaces.

drawer-grip.purpose: The handle of a bottom-edge drawer that closes it by drag or press, disabled while the drawer is locked.

face.purpose: A round decorative mark that identifies a title or an option by icon, document, status, symbol or flag.

fact-group.purpose: Show the facts of one object: image fields as images and every other field as a labelled row.

fact-list.purpose: One pane holding fact rows as a description list.

fact-row.purpose: Keep a capitalized label on the left and its value or its control right-aligned, with shared horizontal dividers and balanced wrapping.

fact-value.purpose: Read one scalar fact as text, or show that it is unknown or empty with a muted icon and an accessible state.

facts.purpose: Read a labeled value, including the difference between an empty value and an unknown value.

failure-dialog.purpose: Explain a failed command in a problem dialog derived from its failure code, saying when the outcome is uncertain.

feedback.purpose: A short status sentence, announced politely, that tells the person what just happened.

field.purpose: Write a single line or several, or open a choice, in one labelled well with field help and validation feedback.

field-well.purpose: Frame one editor in a rounded well whose label floats when empty and settles above the value when filled or focused.

field-well-content.purpose: Keep a field's label persistently above its editor or value, as a label for the editor or as text inside a button.

fields.purpose: Mount each field of a form frame through the node renderer and report its edits and control events.

file-control.purpose: Select supported local files and inspect their limits before an operation uses them.

form.purpose: Submit a labelled group of fields together, from any of its fields or its submit action.

frame-body.purpose: Render the body of a surface frame by its content kind and route its events to the frame.

gallery.purpose: Page through a set of photos in place, inline, heading a place or as a detail's photograph, and open them in the viewer.

grid.purpose: Lay pieces out in auto-fitted tracks of one recipe (tiles, collections, cards, covers) with a gap from the spacing scale.

grouped-panel.purpose: Hold sibling rows in one shared pane, at the reading measure or the full overview width.

heading.purpose: A title whose meaning picks its type role and level: display, page, section or field group.

icon.purpose: Draw one named glyph of the product's icon set, optionally toned, sized to the text or placed inside a control.

identity.purpose: Show the signed-in identity's display name, identity name and role, or say that identity access is not installed.

image.purpose: Show a public or private image at the rendition its frame needs, hidden until decoded, with a fallback and optional retry, or the placeholder of missing artwork.

information.purpose: Group related facts in one pane while leaving reading paragraphs in the content stack.

inline.purpose: Lay pieces out in a horizontal sequence with a gap from the spacing scale: wrapping, in a labelled scroll rail, or neither.

inspection.purpose: Browse the local inspection catalog and open one of its records as a detail, without product commands.

inspection-catalog.purpose: Discover foundations and compositions through the same action rows and destination navigation used by the product.

inspection-content.purpose: Mount the visual catalog inspection and reveal one of its entries for a caller that binds it.

instance-frame.purpose: Draw the transient frame of one mounted instance, keeping its callbacks through teardown.

label-rail.purpose: Present selected labels in a wrapping rail using the same value representation as the field.

labels-control.purpose: Compose the field well, value rail and options from the same shared owners as every labels control.

library.purpose: Browse a media library by album and open its items in the viewer, returning focus to the opener.

list.purpose: Hold sibling rows or facts in one shared pane, at the reading measure or the full overview width.

loading.purpose: Show that content is on its way, as skeleton lines or a spinner, and announce it by its label.

local-exercise-content.purpose: Present the local exercises place as a draft its own events reduce, forwarding catalog navigation to the host.

local-exercises.purpose: Draw the public catalog's local exercises and raise their node events toward the catalog.

lock-screen.purpose: Unlock the selected identity while its private content stays hidden.

masked-input.purpose: Edit a masked value such as a decimal amount: format while typing, keep the caret and undo, report the canonical value.

measured-field.purpose: Give one form control the preferred measure of its family inside the available space, with its invalid and disabled state.

media-collection-grid.purpose: Show media collections as a grid of covers with title and item count, and open the one the person picks.

media-content.purpose: Mount a view's media library at its open album and reveal a record in it on request.

media-control.purpose: Show a tag, an avatar or a captioned image read-only, without turning it into an action.

media-grid.purpose: Browse a media collection as artwork tiles or list rows and open one item.

media-object.purpose: Show the media fact of an object's context: playable audio or video, an image, or a placeholder when unavailable.

media-player.purpose: Play a video or audio item with its transport, seek and volume controls, showing artwork for audio and a retry when unavailable.

media-reference-selector.purpose: Select media references from a shared field without introducing another media library or creation path.

media-reference-specimen.purpose: Witness the media reference selector in the bank with one local image and local state.

media-viewer.purpose: Show images, audio and video full screen with paging, zoom and playback, and return focus to what opened them.

message-body.purpose: Read a surface frame's message as a status paragraph, or as the description of a message dialog.

meter.purpose: Show a total split into labelled segments: the total, a bar proportional to each segment and the legend.

money-control.purpose: Enter an amount and choose its currency without losing the lexical draft.

node-renderer.purpose: Mount the piece for a resolved node kind and translate its callbacks into node events.

object-state-control.purpose: Choose an object state through a contextual command; a retained selection is not a required form input.

object-state-row.purpose: Use a named state selector that dispatches canonical commands without adding toolbar shortcuts.

options-control.purpose: Choose one or several values from a divided group of options.

panel.purpose: Keep an owned view panel mounted across open and close, routing its events with the owner it was mounted for.

photo-collection.purpose: Page through a set of photos in place and open them in the full-screen viewer.

picker-sheet.purpose: Present a picker as a bottom sheet with a grip and a close toolbar, returning focus to its trigger on dismissal.

place.purpose: Arrange content and top or bottom toolbars, with lateral surfaces only at the root. Mounted surfaces keep their own content and toolbars.

place-content.purpose: Show a place's checked content: its header and each of its stacks.

place-header.purpose: Head a place's content with its title, its subtitle and an optional background image, never a toolbar.

place-heading.purpose: Head a place, or content embedded in one, with its title, subtitle and optional featured media.

playback-canvas.purpose: Play a video or audio item attached to its playback controller, showing artwork for audio and a retry when unavailable.

playback-controls.purpose: Play, pause, mute, set the volume of and seek a media playback, one part at a time.

popover-control.purpose: Read contextual information in a temporary surface anchored to its trigger.

problem.purpose: Explain a warning or error in a modal message the person dismisses unless it is locked.

public-catalog-bank.purpose: Show the component bank in the workspace and let the workspace reveal and focus one of its entries.

public-catalog-bank-specimen.purpose: Render one bank node with local diagnostic interaction, an opener for dialogs, and a notice instead of product effects.

public-catalog-product.purpose: Mount the public catalog product content for the built public catalog page.

public-catalog-product-content.purpose: Browse a published catalog, its exercises and its component bank, with search and browser history that return to where the person was.

reading-content.purpose: Read paragraphs at a comfortable measure, outside the two-column layout used for properties.

reference-selector.purpose: Choose referenced objects through a labeled field and the shared selection popover.

reference-specimen.purpose: Exercise one labels or reference owner in the bank with local example values and no product command.

reference-values.purpose: Read selected object references using their labels and shared value layout.

related-selection.purpose: Edit related objects within the current context using shared choices and explicit local feedback.

retained-place.purpose: Keep a place mounted while hidden and provide whether it is the active surface.

review.purpose: Inspect the prepared result before accepting a change or recovering an uncertain result.

row.purpose: Open one object or destination from a list row, or read one, and say why an unavailable one cannot open.

scroll-edges.purpose: Fade the edges of a scroll viewport under its toolbars while there is content left to scroll there.

search-field.purpose: Type a query in a search well with a search icon and a clear button.

seed-avatar.purpose: Generate a deterministic visual identity from a seed without displaying letters or initials.

select-control.purpose: Choose one value from a labeled field and a shared options popover.

selection-field.purpose: Choose one value from a list of options, inline, as a field well or as a contextual value.

separator.purpose: Draw a hairline in the separator ink between the pieces of a column or a row, optionally inset like grouped rows.

shared-owner-catalog.purpose: Show one shared owner's live example, the parts it is composed of, and its contract: who owns it and where its source lives.

shared-owner-specimen.purpose: Exercise one shared catalog owner with local example data, without running product commands.

shell.purpose: Host a workspace place with its navigation sidebar, toolbars, search overlay, panels and failure dialog.

spacer.purpose: Leave an empty space of one spacing step, or take the space a row or column leaves over.

specimen.purpose: Witness one resolved node in one scenario, with local interaction, through the product node and frame grammar.

specimen-group.purpose: Group the bank examples of one resolved node kind under a state chooser and its contract inspection.

specimen-row.purpose: Witness one fixture state of a bank entry, marking whether it is rendered or a gap, inside its own heading scope.

specimen-unavailable.purpose: Explain in place of a bank specimen why it cannot be executed here.

speed-dial.purpose: Reveal overflowing contextual commands beside their readable labels, without putting content navigation in the toolbar.

stack.purpose: Draw one titled stack of a place's items, each through the node renderer.

stack-item.purpose: Place one entry of a stack at the content or the surface inset.

stack-layout.purpose: Group related content under one title, with an optional description and required mark.

status.purpose: Say why there is nothing to show (empty, offline, a note) and what to do next, as a block or a compact caption.

summary-widget.purpose: Show module status at a glance and open its destination.

surface.purpose: Arrange content and top or bottom toolbars, with lateral surfaces only at the root. Mounted surfaces keep their own content and toolbars.

surface-frame.purpose: Frame one surface with its top toolbar, scrolling content and, when it has choices to make, its bottom toolbar.

surface-specimen.purpose: Demonstrate a mounted surface, the transient it launches, and the rules of surface composition.

tag.purpose: Show one label as a toned chip, removable when its owner allows, or a reference as its name beside its color.

text.purpose: A paragraph of plain text in a type role and tone, optionally announced as a status or inset to align with rows.

text-content.purpose: Place a view's text item as reading content in the stack.

text-input.purpose: Write a single line or several with a persistent label, field help and validation feedback.

theme-preview.purpose: Compare Dark and Light using the same surface, tint and wallpaper tokens as the running interface.

toolbar.purpose: Show a surface's toolbar commands (title, navigation, actions) and invoke the intent of the one pressed.

toolbar-layout.purpose: Keep navigation and contextual commands in the surface toolbar; reveal its title and subtitle only after the content header scrolls away.

toolbar-media-controls.purpose: Show transport, media thumbnails and volume for the media selected in a toolbar.

toolbar-search.purpose: Search the items of a toolbar's place: a search field revealed by a toggle that also closes the search.

utility-actions.purpose: Stack a frame's utility actions as secondary actions and pass the pressed one's intent to the host.

view-attention.purpose: Show the work that needs attention in a view and resume one item from it.

view-content.purpose: Declared as found at the start of the migration: ViewContent.svelte.

view-destination-link.purpose: Navigate or invoke an action through a row with a representative icon, distinct from object rows.

view-item.purpose: Mount the piece for one view item's kind (text, fact, destination link, bound node or summary widget).

view-panel.purpose: Present a view's resolved panel as a confirmation dialog or a drawer, reporting its events as node events.

view-product.purpose: Declared as found at the start of the migration: ViewProduct.svelte.

view-product-content.purpose: Run a view program's browser session and render its workspace from the live snapshot.

view-region.purpose: Frame one view's content, one of its items, a place's document or a retained place with the identity navigation reveals; bare renders content unframed.

view-related-selection.purpose: Mount the related selection of a view panel and forward its changes as node events.

view-workspace.purpose: Present a view program as a workspace with navigation, search, retained views and its panel.

viewer.purpose: Show images, audio and video full screen with paging, zoom and playback controls.

wallpaper.purpose: Provide system-generated Silk, Mist or Plain backgrounds that follow the selected appearance.

workspace.purpose: Mount the workspace of a view program with its resolved view, panel, error and events.

zoom-controls.purpose: Step a media view's zoom out or in between 100% and its maximum, and reset it from the shown percentage.
